title: One underlying the operator has forbidden new entry on
description: Source: src/box/underlyingExclusions.ts UnderlyingExclusion, persisted in box_excluded_underlyings (migration 012). An exclusion refuses ENTRY ONLY, in every execution mode (paper_touch, paper_latency, paper_legging, live). It NEVER refuses an exit, a reduction, a protective cancel or a flatten — a box already open on an excluded name keeps streaming, keeps being monitored and still exits on its own rules, because excluding a name must not trap real exposure. Enforced at four independent synchronous chokepoints, of which the two in BoxExecutionSimulator and CentralBoxExecutionGateway cannot be disabled by configuration.

symbol.description: The underlying as the board reports it, uppercased and trimmed (e.g. NIFTY, RELIANCE, M&M). Never blank.

reason.description: Bounded operator note (at most 280 characters). null means no reason was recorded — never that no reason existed.

excluded_by.description: The operator ROLE that added the exclusion. Never a token, key, account or session identifier.
